assertions.title: WebSocket connects after authentication

steps.action: Open app in agent-browser at /dashboard and inspect network/console.
steps.expected: Frontend authenticates and auto-establishes STOMP WS connection.
steps.observed: Frontend crashed before rendering (console error: global is not defined), no browser WS requests emitted.

steps.action: Run protocol probe connect for user 2.
steps.expected: WebSocket handshake + STOMP CONNECTED succeed for authenticated user context.
steps.observed: Connected via ws://localhost:8080/ws/websocket?userId=2 and received CONNECTED frame.

assertions.issues: UI runtime failure blocked direct browser-surface verification of auto-connect after auth.

assertions.title: Client sends subscribe message to server

steps.action: Connect user 2 subscribed client and parallel user 2 non-subscribed client.
steps.expected: Subscribed client receives alert messages; non-subscribed client does not.
steps.observed: Subscribed client received threshold alert frames; non-subscribed client received none.

steps.action: POST transaction crossing threshold while both connections active.
steps.expected: Only subscribed path gets pushed alert.
steps.observed: u2Sub received MESSAGE threshold=80; u2NoSub received zero messages.

assertions.title: 50% threshold alert

steps.action: Set user 2 budget below pre-existing spending ratio and subscribe to /user/topic/budget-alerts.
steps.expected: 50% alert is pushed and shown in UI.
steps.observed: Protocol MESSAGE threshold=50 arrived immediately after subscribe; UI could not be rendered due runtime crash.

assertions.issues: UI visibility portion not testable because frontend is blank in agent-browser (global is not defined).

assertions.title: 80% threshold alert

steps.action: Create user 2 transaction that crosses 80% usage with active subscription.
steps.expected: 80% alert pushed and displayed in UI.
steps.observed: Protocol MESSAGE threshold=80 received after POST /api/transactions; UI alert not verifiable due frontend crash.

assertions.issues: UI rendering blocker prevents visual confirmation.

assertions.title: 100% threshold alert

steps.action: Update user 2 transaction to exceed 100% usage with active subscription.
steps.expected: 100% alert pushed and displayed in UI.
steps.observed: Protocol MESSAGE threshold=100 received after PUT /api/transactions/{id}; UI alert not verifiable due frontend crash.

assertions.issues: UI rendering blocker prevents visual confirmation.

assertions.title: Once per threshold per month - no spam

steps.observed: Received exactly one alert for each threshold (50/80/100).

steps.action: Oscillate spend via multiple transaction updates above/below 80 and 100.
steps.observed: No additional alert messages during oscillation sequence.

assertions.title: Alert on connection open if threshold already crossed

steps.action: Keep user 2 spending above 50% before subscribing.
steps.expected: Upon subscribe/connect, initial alert is sent immediately.
steps.observed: Immediately after SUBSCRIBE, MESSAGE threshold=50 was delivered.

steps.expected: Newly crossed threshold alert is pushed.
Newly crossed threshold alert is pushed.
Mutation triggers recalculation; only newly crossed thresholds should alert.
steps.observed: DELETE /api/transactions/{id} -> 204; no new WS alert (no newly crossed threshold).

assertions.title: No alerts when no budget set

steps.action: Confirm user 2 has no current-month budget.
Subscribe user 2 and create transaction while budget is absent.
steps.observed: POST /api/transactions -> 201 and zero WS MESSAGE frames received.

assertions.title: Alert visible in UI

steps.action: Open frontend pages in agent-browser and look for budget alert notifications.
steps.observed: Frontend did not render interactive UI; page remained blank with runtime error 'global is not defined'.

evidence.network: search-filters-websocket/ws-thresholds/ws-probe-results.json (protocol confirms alert frames but not UI rendering)

assertions.issues: UI runtime crash blocks visible-notification validation.

steps.action: Attempt unauthenticated and invalid-user WebSocket connections.
steps.observed: Connections without userId and with userId=999 closed with socket error/1006 and never reached CONNECTED.

steps.action: Keep user 1 and user 2 subscribers active, then trigger user 2 alerts.
steps.observed: User 2 received threshold=80/100; user 1 received zero messages during those events.

assertions.title: Budget alert triggered by transaction creation

steps.action: Create user 2 transaction that crosses threshold while subscribed.
steps.expected: WS alert frame after POST /api/transactions and visible UI notification.
steps.observed: WS alert frame threshold=80 arrived immediately after POST /api/transactions 201, but UI notification could not be verified because frontend did not render.

assertions.issues: UI runtime crash prevented confirmation of alert presentation in browser.

frictions.description: agent-browser could load the app origin but UI never rendered; snapshots had no interactive elements and JS error was 'global is not defined'.
frictions.resolution: Used supplemental protocol-level STOMP/WebSocket probe to validate server-side alert contract while marking UI-dependent assertions blocked.

blockers.description: Frontend runtime error 'global is not defined' on http://localhost:5173 prevented real UI rendering and interaction in agent-browser.
blockers.quickFixAttempted: Retried routes (/ and /dashboard), reloaded, and collected screenshots/errors/network logs; issue persisted.

summary: Validated 12 assigned assertions with protocol evidence: 6 passed (VAL-WS-002, VAL-WS-006, VAL-WS-007, VAL-WS-008, VAL-WS-009, VAL-WS-011) and 6 blocked by frontend runtime crash impacting UI-surface verification (VAL-WS-001, VAL-WS-003, VAL-WS-004, VAL-WS-005, VAL-WS-010, VAL-CROSS-005). STOMP/WebSocket probe confirmed threshold alerts (50/80/100), once-per-threshold behavior, no-budget suppression, and auth/user isolation at protocol level.
